candidates.triggerInput: A Codex reviewer returns the deterministic receipt object without reading one or more frozen snapshot artifacts.
candidates.requiredState: The reviewer completes with a valid same-session handshake and a receipt equal to artifact_view_read_receipt(manifest).
candidates.badOutcome: The controller publishes formal complete coverage for all frozen artifacts although the reviewer did not inspect required context, allowing a clean result or incomplete candidate set to pass the evidence-gated review.
candidates.existingGuardAnalysis: The handshake verifies that each snapshot exists and hashes correctly, and this function verifies only schema conformance and equality to the receipt derived from the manifest. Neither binding records or verifies per-artifact reviewer reads; the expected receipt is a constant function of the manifest and can be returned before semantic inspection.
candidates.severityRationale: This defeats the mandatory complete-context review gate for the skill-route control plane. It can produce an apparently complete review that omits authority, route, schema, test, or usage evidence, but does not directly alter protected repository files or bypass launch authorization.
